title: Cratus – Smart Theft Resistance Cabinet
headings: Cabinet Manufacturers & Enclosure Experts for Critical Infrastructure - Standard, Armored, Anti-Theft, & How You Envision
Advanced Protection for Power & Telecom Infrastructure
Multi-Layered Theft Protection for Power Equipment
Cratus MONITOR -  Intelligent Dashboard for Power & Security Management​
content: From standard battery cabinets to six-layer anti-theft, armored to bespoke enclosures – Cratus protects critical infrastructure at telecom towers, energy sites, and industrial deployments Globally. Cratus Protected Sites Worth of Assets Secured Drill-resistant, flame-resistant, and triple-locking mechanisms ensure maximum security. Vibration alarms, torch sensors, and integration with NOC systems provide instant alerts on security breaches. Live alerts, remote diagnostics, and automated reporting Cutting-edge anti-theft battery and power protection solutions to safeguard telecom and energy assets. With real-time monitoring, keyless access, and advanced security layers , we ensure maximum protection against theft and environmental threats. Engineered with drill-resistant, flame-proof, and impact-resistant materials for unmatched security. Equipped with vibration sensors, GPS tracking, and hooter alarms to detect and prevent theft in real time. Live system updates, remote diagnostics, real-time alerts, maintenance tracking, and custom reporting. Cratus SAFE is designed with six layers of advanced security to safeguard critical power infrastructure from theft and tampering. It features drill-resistant and flame-proof materials , a triple-locking mechanism , and reinforced structural integrity to withstand forced entry attempts. Additionally, integrated vibration sensors, real-time alerts, emergency hooter, torch sensor, cabinet keyless entry and emergency exhaust systems provide proactive protection, ensuring your valuable assets remain secure at all times . Six layers for Theft Protection Vibration Sensor, Hooter, GPS & Torch Sensor Keyless Operation via NOC & Mobile Application Temperature, Humidity, Flood & Smoke Sensors Manufacturing Facilities From reliable power distribution and battery backup to rapid deployment, our solutions are designed to adapt to every infrastructure requirement . Reliable backup power for seamless telecom operations. The Cratus Standard Battery Cabinet ensures reliable backup power with its durable GI sheet construction and modular design . It combines safety and efficiency through fire-retardant insulation, built-in HVAC, and a compact footprint for space optimization . Furthermore, the unit features front access to allow for simplified maintenance Efficient power distribution with built-in protection. The Cratus Standard Power Cabinet delivers high-efficiency power distribution with integrated surge protection and a scalable design . This durable, IP65-rated unit ensures long operational life and supports remote monitoring for seamless control . Flexible, space-saving design that grows with your needs The Cratus Stackable Cabinet provides a flexible, space-saving design that grows with your needs . It features modular stacking for space efficiency and supports both battery and equipment storage within a lightweight, durable structure . Additionally, the unit is expandable to meet site requirements, includes a cable management system, and ensures quick installation and relocation . Quick-deploy, weatherproof solution for any environment. The Cratus PreFabricated Cabinet offers a quick-deploy, weatherproof solution suitable for any environment . Arriving fully assembled to reduce installation time and labor costs , it features customizable internal configurations and an integrated thermal management system . Its robust design ensures reliability even in remote and harsh operating conditions . Purpose-built fiber distribution enclosures for last-mile broadband rollouts. The Cratus FTTH Cabinet is engineered for outdoor street-side and premises deployment, housing optical splitters, patch panels, and fiber termination equipment in a secure, weatherproof enclosure. Built for telecom operators scaling residential and commercial fiber networks, it combines robust physical protection with a compact, field-ready design. Weatherproof construction rated IP55 and IP65 or above for all-environment deployment. Anti-theft reinforced steel housing to protect fiber assets in public locations. Customizable port configurations and internal layouts to match operator specs. Thermal management options to maintain optimal equipment operating conditions. Proven in large-scale telecom rollouts across Pakistan and beyond. Cratus MONITOR is an intelligent dashboard software designed to seamlessly integrate with Cratus SAFE for real-time security and power management. It provides live tracking, instant alerts, and remote access , ensuring total visibility and control over your protected assets. With custom reporting, analytics, and automated maintenance notifications , Cratus MONITOR enhances operational efficiency and proactive security management. Instant Security Alerts Remote Access Control Advanced Data Analytics Seamless System Integration Protecting Your Power with Smart Security and Real-Time Monitoring. Monitor asset security in real time with instant notifications for theft attempts, environmental changes, and unauthorized access. Manage security settings, lock/unlock cabinets, and configure alerts from anywhere via the intuitive dashboard. Gain valuable insights with automated reports, performance analytics, and predictive maintenance alerts. With a growing presence in Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and beyond, Cratus continues to support large-scale projects with cutting-edge security and monitoring solutions, ensuring seamless power management. Yes, Cratus cabinets are IP55-rated , meaning they are resistant to dust, water, and extreme temperatures, ensuring reliable performance in harsh environments. If unauthorized movement is detected, the vibration sensor triggers an alarm , sends alerts to the monitoring system, and activates additional security features like geo-fencing and hooter alarms. No, our solutions are designed for plug-and-play integration , making installation simple and efficient with minimal downtime. Absolutely! Cratus systems allow custom security configurations , such as setting access permissions, adjusting sensitivity levels, and integrating with existing monitoring platforms. Cratus solutions are scalable , making them ideal for businesses of all sizes, from small telecom sites to large-scale energy infrastructures. A standard electrical cabinet is designed for containment and environmental protection. An anti-theft cabinet adds physical hardening — reinforced steel, drill-resistant panels, multi-point locks — plus electronic detection systems such as vibration sensors and alarms. Cratus cabinets combine both functions in one enclosure. Yes. All Cratus armored cabinets are rated IP55 or above, providing full protection against dust ingress and water jets. They are field-tested for deployment in extreme heat, humidity, and direct weather exposure. Absolutely. Cratus manufactures anti-theft cabinets to custom dimensions and internal configurations. Our field teams are experienced in large-scale rollouts — we have completed multi-thousand unit deployments with leading telecom operators across Pakistan.
